label: Sun-Crown Griffin first encounter

purpose.value: Above the highland road it shepherds, the guardian of travelers and cliffside roosts wheels down to issue the law's fair warning; the hero hears every word and misreads a weather shepherd's gusts as strafing runs. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by the highland road.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: the highland road. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it.
